'''Arandar''' is a mountain pass leading to [[Tirannwn]] that may be used by players upon completion of the [[Regicide]] quest. Players may use the pass to access the [[Elf|elven]] lands without having to travel through the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] again. Prior to completion, the [[Huge Gate|huge gate]] is a one-way exit, leading to the forest south-west of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]].

The pass was constructed by the elves after the [[God Wars]] as part of "The Break Out".{{CiteText|text=Eastern discovery|quote=In matters of history it is always best to understand some background to the subject you are studying, so we shall have a brief explanation of 'The Break Out'. After centuries of isolated development, after the God Wars, it was decided that the elven domain needed to expand. With their backs to the sea, there was only one way to go, east. After many years of hard work, a pass over the mountains was created. The creation of this pass is a long tale unto itself and we shall leave that subject for another time.}}

==Features==
===Mine===
{{Main|Arandar mine}}
A mine containing [[limestone rock]]s can be found near the southern part of the Arandar pass. It is notable for being one of two mines where limestone can be mined, the other being in [[Silvarea]].

===Monsters===
There are [[Dire Wolf|dire wolves]], [[deadly red spider]]s, and [[Mourner|mourners]] wandering the Arandar path, although most adventurers using the pass will be strong enough to deal with them.

The mourners on the path are involved in the [[Mourning's End Part I]] quest. While they are only level 11, they will throw a vial if attacked, which drastically lowers all [[combat]] stats and [[hitpoints]] down to 20 temporarily; however they are not a threat unless attacked. After completion of the [[Song of the Elves]] quest, mourners no longer appear here. The [[mourner gear]] can be reobtained by searching the chest in front of the burgundy coloured bed under the [[Mourner Headquarters]].

===Shortcuts===
There are three [[Rocks (Tirannwn)|Agility shortcuts]] within the pass that make it easier to traverse, requiring [[Agility]] levels of 59, 68, and 85.

==Trivia==
* It is unclear whether Arandar is the name for the entire mountain/mountain range, or just the pass through it. Some sources suggest Arandar is just the name of the pass,{{CiteNPC|npc=Arianwyn|quote=Those that you know as mourners are in fact elves in service to Lord Iorwerth. We regularly see them crossing the Arandar mountain pass and into the east.|loc=Mourning's End Part I|notes=|name=}} while some others suggest it may be the name of the mountains.{{CiteText|text=Edern's journal|quote=This evening I camp on the peaks of Arandar, tomorrow I report for my first day in service of the Death Guard.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Lord Iorwerth|quote=As a token of my own thanks, I give you access to the pass through Arandar. You'll find the start of the trail in the far north east of the woods.|loc=Regicide|notes=|name=}} Notably, on the world map, the Arandar label is located specifically above the pass.
